hero.subtitle: Versioned schema changes for PostgreSQL. synchronize stays off; pending migrations run on Nest bootstrap or via npm scripts.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Postgres schema is managed with TypeORM migrations under src/database/migrations. MongoDB/Mongoose is unchanged (collections remain model-driven).
items: POSTGRES_SYNCHRONIZE=false — do not auto-alter tables from entities
POSTGRES_MIGRATIONS_RUN=true (default) — apply pending migrations when the API starts
CLI scripts for generate, run, revert, and show
InitialSchema creates users, blocked_ips, and audit

config.title: Configuration
config.description: Connection options live in src/config/database.config.ts. The TypeORM CLI DataSource at src/database/data-source.ts spreads databaseConfig().postgres — it does not load dotenv itself. Ensure POSTGRES_* is set in the shell, Docker env_file, or CI.
envItems: POSTGRES_SYNCHRONIZE — must be false when using migrations
POSTGRES_MIGRATIONS_RUN — default true; set false only if you apply migrations exclusively via CLI

bootCli.title: Boot vs CLI
bootCli.description: On Nest bootstrap, TypeORM runs pending migrations when migrationsRun is true. Use npm scripts for local generation and explicit control:
scripts: npm run migration:generate — replace MigrationName in the script or pass a path to typeorm
npm run migration:run — apply pending migrations
npm run migration:revert — revert the last migration
npm run migration:show — list executed / pending

workflow.title: Workflow
steps: Update the TypeORM entity under src/
Generate a migration (empty target DB or against a DB that matches the previous schema)
Review the generated SQL, then commit it
Deploy — Nest applies it on boot, or run npm run migration:run

docker.title: Docker note
docker.description: If an existing Postgres volume was created with synchronize=true, tables already exist and the initial migration may fail. Recreate the volume once (docker compose down -v) or baseline by recording the migration in the TypeORM migrations table without re-running DDL. Fresh installs need no special step.
